name: Bradbury Landing Site
description: Landing location of Curiosity Rover on Sol 0 (Aug 6, 2012). Smooth alluvial plain deposit.
scientific_significance: Benchmark location for crater floor alluvial fans and baseline soil composition.
data_limitations: Surface altered by rocket descent thruster scouring.

name: Yellowknife Bay (Sheepbed Mudstone)
description: Fine-grained mudstone deposit showing clear evidence of ancient freshwater lake.
scientific_significance: Confirmed ancient habitable environment with neutral pH water, key elements (C, H, N, O, P, S), and smectite clays.
data_limitations: Drill sample analysis completed; spatial extent bounded by local topographic depression.

name: Vera Rubin Ridge (Hematite Unit)
description: Prominent topographic ridge rich in crystalline red hematite (Fe2O3).
scientific_significance: Indicates ancient iron oxidation by liquid groundwater in moderate pH conditions.
data_limitations: Spectral signatures partially obscured by surface dust mantle. Location: Curiosity at the Rock Hall drill site on the ridge, sols 2257-2297 (NASA MSL waypoints).

name: Glen Torridon (Clay-Bearing Unit)
description: Topographic trough containing high concentration of smectite clay minerals.
scientific_significance: Extensive mudstone sequence documenting long-duration standing water in Gale Crater.
data_limitations: Boundary between clay unit and overlying sulfate unit is gradational. Location: Curiosity at the Glen Etive drill site, drilled sol 2486 (NASA MSL waypoints).

name: Sulfate-Bearing Strata
description: Magnesium and calcium sulfate-bearing rock layers marking climatic drying phase.
scientific_significance: Documents major planetary climate transition from wet habitability to hyper-arid conditions.
data_limitations: Point location of one drill site; the sulfate-bearing unit is extensive and its mineralogy varies with elevation. Location: Curiosity at the Canaima drill site, drilled sol 3612 (NASA MSL waypoints).
